text:
emily: Heads up 1: upcoming benchmark case study launch needs a segmented send to our bench list + top customers. Goals: 1) drive 400 benchmark downloads, 2) collect 50 lead qualification forms for enterprise follow-up.

santiago: sounds good. segmentation plan?

emily: bench list = folks who signed up for benchmark content in past year but didn't convert. top customers gets a VIP email with exec summary + CTA to request a walkthrough. bench list split: engaged (opened >2 emails in 90d) vs passive.

lina: cadence: single announce + 3-day reminder to passive segment. VIP gets bespoke note + AE cc.

emily: subject variants for bench list A/B: A) "New: Inference benchmarks that cut cost 2x" B) "Benchmark report: how teams trimmed token costs". test open/CTR.

santiago: creative asks: 1 hero image, 1 downloadable PDF link, 1 inline CTA to form, social proof quote. also short landing page with form capture. who builds LP? product-marketing or growth?

emily: growth to own LP. include hidden field for `utm_campaign=bench_q2` and `lead_source=email_bench`.

ops-bot: Reminder: add `X-Company-ID` header for enterprise leads so AEs can map quickly.

lina: tracking: funnel metrics: delivered->opened->clicked->download->form_submit. target download rate 15% for engaged, 6% for passive.

santiago: make sure the form includes a `company_size` and `use_case` dropdown to help routing. Also include a checkbox for "Request enterprise walkthrough" to flag higher intent.

emily: deliverables:
- LP + form (growth)
- email template + A/B subjects (lina)
- hero image + alt text (design)
- UTM + header plan (santiago)
- AE vip note template (emily)

lina: timeline: assets by Thur, LP live by Fri, send Mon. I'll do seed tests and check rendering.

santiago: plan to gate VIP sends by account list. will sync with AE team for list and CC rules.

emily: small ask: include a short 2-sentence executive summary at top of email for VIPs.

ops-bot: Dry run note: no PII in sample sends. Confirmed.

emily: good. let's keep the benchmark angle focused on measurable unit cost improvements, not raw performance claims.

lina: uploading subject variants and previews in thread. will flag any render quirks.

santiago: analytics dashboard will include cohort by segment and by subject. aiming to publish internal recap within 48h of send.

emily: thanks team  let's finalize by Fri so Monday send is clean.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: assets check at EOD Thu.
